function.name: shap_review
function.description: Evidence-driven SHAP repository review toolkit. Runs semantic analysis, contract oracles, fuzzing, differential analysis, and evidence-chain validation against a SHAP source checkout. SECURITY: commands 'differential', 'reproduce', 'sanitizer', 'cpu-gpu-differential', and 'differential-versions' execute arbitrary Python scripts via subprocess — only use with trusted, controlled paths.

arguments.description: Command-specific keyword arguments. The 'root' key specifies the repository path for analysis commands.

security_note: Commands in script_execution_commands execute arbitrary Python scripts via subprocess. Only invoke with trusted, controlled input paths.

evidence_model.name: EvidenceChain
evidence_model.dynamic_evidence_note: The 'analyze' command runs a bounded TreeExplainer campaign against the installed SHAP runtime, not the repository under review. The runtime-bridge.json artifact records anomalies but those anomalies do not currently enrich candidate evidence chains because the generic bridge campaign does not set per-candidate fingerprints.
